items.title: Why Did AMETEK (AME) Stock Fall After Record Results And Raised Guidance?
items.summary: AMETEK (NYSE: AME) reported record third quarter 2026 results that came in above analyst expectations on Wednesday, 4 November 2026. The company closed the Indicor Instrumentation acquisition, described by management as a major transaction for its instrumentation portfolio. Management raised full year 2026 guidance following the contribution from Indicor, yet the share price declined after the announcement.
